rationale: vg-paradigms' two grafts of 2026-10-31 (CI off; git's global hooks): the workflow is replaced by a local check script, and the hook and remote-builder work is planned against what it waits on.; vg-paradigms' update to graft 01a19407: remote builders are part of the ask.

ops.text: No CI: nix/scripts/check.sh (`just check`) runs every check before each commit; still not `nix flake check`
ops.why: The user turned CI off for projects with one contributor (2026-10-31; vg-paradigms rule ci.contributors-only) and disabled GitHub Actions on vg-dotfiles, so .github/workflows/check.yml is gone (vg-paradigms' graft 01a19343). Its steps moved unchanged into nix/scripts/check.sh: check-hosts.sh evaluates every host (hosts without hardware-configuration.nix PENDING), exports.test.sh, a build of vgwsl2's home-files (an eval-only check once let a build failure ship), shellcheck through the root dev shell, and the bootstrap and wallpaper tests. It runs on any Linux machine with Nix (vghydra: wsl -d NixOS -- bash nix/scripts/check.sh) and runs every step, exiting 1 if any failed. Verified 2026-10-31 on vgwsl2: all six steps pass; a control with a failing step exits 1 and names it. `nix flake check` still waits on the bare-metal hosts' hardware configs; once tend's git hook dispatcher exists, the pre-commit hook runs these.

ops.text: CI off: the workflow's checks run locally before every commit
ops.why: vg-paradigms asked (graft 01a19343, superseded the same day): GitHub Actions is disabled on vg-dotfiles and only the user commits here, so .github/workflows/check.yml is deleted rather than reduced to workflow_dispatch. Nothing it checked is dropped: nix/scripts/check.sh runs the same steps and `just check` calls it. README's Day to day says so.

ops.title: Flake `checks` running `nix flake check`, from check.sh
ops.body: Once every bare-metal host has its hardware-configuration.nix: expose the check-hosts evaluations (and what nix/scripts/check.sh runs) as flake `checks` (forAllSystems, eval-only derivations), so `nix flake check -L` holds everything check.sh does (baseline rule nix.flake-check). No CI: the repo has none since 2026-10-31; check.sh (and later the pre-commit hook) runs it locally.

A checks VM test with modules.tenstorrent off: services come up, a user without an association is refused, one with it runs sbatch, user.slice carries the caps. Needs KVM and flake checks; with no CI, KVM comes from a bare-metal host here or a remote builder (todo: Nix remote builders for KVM checks).

ops.title: Git's global core.hooksPath runs tend's hook dispatcher on every Nix machine
ops.body: vg-paradigms' graft 01a19407: in home/modules/git, set programs.git's core.hooksPath (global, every host) to the dispatcher tend is asked to build (pre-commit, pre-push, post-merge, post-checkout: tend's checks where .tend exists, nothing elsewhere, and always the repo's own .git/hooks/<name>). Add it as a switch on the git module per the mk*Option claim, on by default. Then make nix/scripts/check.sh what this repo's pre-commit runs. Waits on tend's graft 01a19407-a869 (the dispatcher and how it's installed: a store path from tend's package, or a path tend writes).

waits_on.note: tend's hook dispatcher, not built yet

ops.title: Nix remote builders for KVM checks (NixOS VM tests) from any machine
ops.body: vg-paradigms' graft 01a19407 suggests it: with no CI, a NixOS VM test needs a Linux machine with KVM; vgwsl2 has none until Microsoft fixes nested virtualization (graft 01a165ae). Declare nix.buildMachines (and distributedBuilds, the builder's ssh key, its trusted user) on the clients, pointing at a bare-metal NixOS host over the tailnet. Which host builds is the user's choice when the time comes (vgkraken, or a vgsquid server once one is up); none of them is on the tailnet yet.

waits_on.on: a bare-metal NixOS host with KVM up on the tailnet
waits_on.note: vgkraken, vgnixmini and the vgsquid servers are declared but not on the tailnet yet

ops.title: Nix remote builders: a KVM Linux host for NixOS VM tests, vgmacbook for aarch64-darwin
ops.body: Part of vg-paradigms' graft 01a19407 (its update of 2026-10-31: the user decided tests for other systems run on these machines through Nix remote builders, CI only when none can). (1) Declare the builders: a bare-metal NixOS host with KVM that's always on (vgsquid-jade is the likely one; the user confirms) with supportedFeatures kvm, nixos-test, big-parallel, and vgmacbook for aarch64-darwin; nix.buildMachines and nix.distributedBuilds on the clients, vgwsl2 included (how vghydra runs Nix); a builder user each builder trusts; ssh keys from the secret backends, never in the repo. (2) Check it: `nix flake check` on a client hands a VM test to the builder, and a deliberately broken check fails it the same way (the control). vgwsl2 has no KVM of its own until Microsoft fixes nested virtualization (graft 01a165ae).

wait.note: the KVM builder (vgsquid-jade, unless the user picks another) has to be up and on the tailnet
